title: Figure 4: Cross-section micrograph of a SiC fiber titanium matrix composite
description: Light micrograph showing a dense, regular array of circular fiber cross-sections with small dark centers, with a 1.0 mm scale bar. Caption: "Figure 4. Cross-Section Micrograph of a Ti Matrix Composite." noting C monofilament substrates for SiC deposition, a Ti-6242 matrix and SCS-6 fiber. The text discusses Textron Specialty Materials and SiC fiber availability for TMCs.
